about: Scripted agent events for tests and demo films (plans/06-board.md). Not part of any live board.

add.title: Review's contract: Flex's as it is, or trimmed for software?
add.summary: Flex's contract carries film-only fields (song, film, scenes, playheads). Review needs phases, commits, URLs and the owed list instead.

why: Keep Flex's core and add software's fields beside it. Items, stages, decisions, basis, unsure, then, settled, working, log and demo carry over unchanged, so Flex's page and Review read the same core. Film fields stay optional; Review adds phase, commit, open (URL, logs, file:line), owed and short.

options.label: Flex's core, unchanged, plus optional software fields
options.then: Write the shared core as a schema both Flex and Switchboard validate against, and add Review's fields as optional.
out: Adds phase, commit, open, owed, short

options.label: Fork it: a separate contract for Review

add.title: Should .review/ be committed?
add.summary: Cards in the repo travel with the work, but every card update becomes a change in git.

unsure.why: Committing it keeps the board's history beside the code, and a teammate who clones the repo sees what's open. But the agent updates cards often (progress, versions), so diffs fill up with board churn, and answers would need to stay out of it.
unsure.where: prod-app/REVIEW-BOARD.html's history (19 commits for one board) and git log --stat on a busy day.

options.label: Commit cards, ignore progress and answers
options.then: Split .review/ into committed cards and an ignored state/ folder for progress, versions and your answers.
